verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer page claims 'access to developer documentation and sandbox environment' for app developers, so a first-party sandbox exists. But that one marketing line is the only evidence, with no detail on how it is provisioned, what data it holds, or how it is kept apart from production. Missing for 10: documented sandbox provisioning and setup, explicit separation from production data and seeded test data, API or CLI targeting of the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
